findings.name: Super Saiyan God
findings.finding: Ki-recovery modifier remains source-sensitive: maintained structured corpus reports +50%, while earlier repository research promoted +60%. Canonical record now explicitly preserves the conflict rather than asserting a single number.

findings.name: Potential Unleashed
findings.finding: +15% all attack and +5% defense retained. Claims of a real Ki-recovery bonus were not promoted because the maintained research corpus flags the in-game recovery wording as misleading.

findings.name: Beast
findings.finding: +30% attack and a roughly 20% defense penalty are retained; documentation varies between negative-defense and damage-taken notation, so the canonical note records both conventions.

findings.name: Future Super Saiyan
findings.finding: Faster Stamina regeneration retained; conflicting Ki/Stamina wording is preserved rather than normalized away.

policy: Mechanics with conflicting current sources are qualified in canonical notes. No unsupported single-value replacement is made solely to satisfy a table.
duplicate_check: No new canonical Awoken records created.
